title: review admission survives observer timeouts under host load
body:
Outcome: review admission does not refuse a slice because its observer timed out under host load; the observer run uses a timeout that scales or is long enough for test/deliver/delivery.test.ts at load ~40, or the refusal names load and the slice reruns it without a lead wait loop.
Evidence: #209 slice review exit 64 "FAIL test/deliver/delivery.test.ts: head: timeout" at load 47 (blender render, not KRN); .krn/runs/lead/main-red-hygiene/slice-review.log; the lead waited ~30 min for load <30 before a rerun passed admission.
Proof: an observer runs admission with a stub test that exceeds the current per-test timeout only under a simulated slow runner and asserts the chosen behaviour.
